section: noncomputable section; open Set Filter Topology; namespace BanditRL.OnlineConvex

owned_definitions.SourceFiniteMax:
def SourceFiniteMax {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (f : ι → E → EReal) (x : E) : EReal := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => f i x)

/-- Full global supports of all functions attaining the maximum at the query. -/

SourceSubdifferential.body:
def SourceSubdifferential (f : E → EReal) (x : E) : Set E :=
  {g | ∀ y, f x + (inner ℝ g (y - x) : EReal) ≤ f y}

SourceProper.body:
def SourceProper (f : E → EReal) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, f x ≠ ⊥) ∧ ∃ x, ∃ r : ℝ, f x = (r : EReal)

effectiveDomain.body:
def effectiveDomain (f : E → EReal) : Set E := {x | f x < ⊤}

/-- Epigraph heights are real, as in the source subset of R^(d+1). -/

realEpigraph.body:
def realEpigraph (f : E → EReal) : Set (E × ℝ) := {p | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)}

/-- Definition 2.3 permits both infinite function values. -/

IsConvexExtended.body:
def IsConvexExtended (f : E → EReal) : Prop := Convex ℝ (realEpigraph f)

/-- Extended-real constraint indicator, distinct from the zero-outside Set.indicator. -/
